description:
Debug Network Faster & Smarter with Proxyman

Proxyman is a high-performance Windows app, which enables developers to capture, inspect, and manipulate HTTP/HTTPS requests/responses with ease.
✨ Features
- App language: You can now use Proxyman in Simplified Chinese.

⚡️ Improve
- HTTP and HTTPS proxying now handles large bodies, redirects, and connection errors better.

🐞 Bugs
- Fixed: Certificate names with non-English characters now stay correct after relaunch.
- Fixed: Windows now waits for PowerShell to finish installing the certificate.
